signature: SUBROUTINE ZLAQP2( M, N, OFFSET, A, LDA, JPVT, TAU, VN1, VN2,

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: offset
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A that must be pivoted but no factorized. $\mathrm{OFFSET} \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N matrix A. On exit, the upper triangle of block `A(OFFSET+1:M,1:N)` is the triangular factor obtained; the elements in block `A(OFFSET+1:M,1:N)` below the diagonal, together with the array `TAU`, represent the orthogonal matrix Q as a product of elementary reflectors. Block `A(1:OFFSET,1:N)` has been accordingly pivoted, but no factorized.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: JPVT
params.reference: On entry, if $\mathrm{JPVT}(i) \ne 0$, the i-th column of A is permuted to the front of $A \, P$ (a leading column); if `JPVT(i) = 0`, the i-th column of A is a free column. On exit, if `JPVT(i) = k`, then the i-th column of $A \, P$ was the k-th column of A.

params.name: TAU
params.reference: The scalar factors of the elementary reflectors.

params.name: VN1
params.reference: The vector with the partial column norms.

params.name: VN2
params.reference: The vector with the exact column norms.
